narrative.overview: The site is a threshold. A visitor, usually on a phone, arrives and sees the community's own faces first, under a dark ink wash, and the next thing to attend one tap away. It is reverent and confident: big, heavy type states who the community is without hype, and the warmth comes from real photography and from logo red and gold, not from decoration.
keyCharacteristics: Photo-led, ink-grounded hero with a bottom gradient.
Heavy Hanken Grotesk (800) with tight negative tracking for headings.
Red is the action color, gold is its hover on dark.
Pills and 20-24px rounded cards; no shadows.
Responsive by grid wrapping, not breakpoints.

rules.name: The One Action Rule
rules.body: Red is the only action color. Gold appears as hover or kicker on dark, never as a second button color on light.

rules.name: The Warm Neutral Rule
rules.body: Every neutral leans warm toward the logo; no cool or pure gray surfaces.

rules.name: The Heavy and Tight Rule
rules.body: Headings are weight 800 with negative tracking (-0.03 to -0.035em); body never goes below 400.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces carry no shadow. Hover lifts a card 2-3px (translateY) and nothing else.

dos: Do use Candle Red (#c8161d) for every primary action and Warm Ink (#2a2523) for dark grounds.
Do keep headings at weight 800 with negative tracking.
Do let photos carry warmth and place white text only over the ink gradient.
Do size touch targets for thumbs: pills and generous card padding.
donts: Don't add shadows; use borders, photos or ink sections for depth.
Don't add a donation button or call to action.
Don't introduce cool or pure gray neutrals, or a second action color.
Don't invent testimonials, numbers or other proof.
